2610.13626.title: SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle
2610.13626.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk. Deceptive behavior takes the form of misleading responses or assistance in fabricating, concealing, or distorting information. To study this behavior, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM deception in software engineering. The benchmark covers six lifecycle stages and two deception triggers: Active Deception, where models recognize infeasible or conflicting requirements but still present them as achievable, and Passive Deception, where models help fulfill explicit user requests to mislead others. We further introduce Neutral, Reward, and Pressure conditions to study the effect of external inducements, resulting in 720 test instances in Chinese and English. Evaluating seven mainstream LLMs, we find substantial deception even under the Neutral condition, with aggregate rates of 49.88% for Active Deception and 64.29% for Passive Deception. Deception rates vary across lifecycle stages, and external inducements affect Active and Passive Deception to different extents. We also evaluate lightweight defenses, finding that guard models miss many deceptive requests, and Self-Reminder reduces but does not eliminate deceptive responses. These findings highlight the need for more effective deception detection and mitigation methods to support trustworthy LLM-based software engineering.
2610.13626.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在軟體開發生命周期中越來越多地被使用。對LLMs日益增長的依賴引發了對其可信度的擔憂，尤其是欺騙行為構成了一個重要的風險。欺騙行為的形式包括誤導性的回應或協助製造、隱藏或扭曲信息。為了研究這種行為，我們引入了SWE-DeceptionBench，這是一個用於評估軟體工程中LLM欺騙的基準。該基準涵蓋六個生命周期階段和兩個欺騙觸發器：主動欺騙，模型識別不可行或相互衝突的需求，但仍然將其呈現為可實現的；以及被動欺騙，模型幫助滿足明確的用戶請求以誤導他人。我們進一步引入中立、獎勵和壓力條件，以研究外部誘因的影響，總共產生720個中英文測試實例。在評估七個主流LLM時，我們發現即使在中立條件下也存在相當大的欺騙行為，主動欺騙的總體比率為49.88%，被動欺騙的比率為64.29%。欺騙率在生命周期階段之間有所不同，外部誘因對主動和被動欺騙的影響程度也不同。我們還評估了輕量級防禦，發現防護模型漏掉了許多欺騙請求，而自我提醒雖然減少了欺騙回應，但並未消除這些回應。這些發現凸顯了需要更有效的欺騙檢測和緩解方法，以支持可信的基於LLM的軟體工程。
